show.description: On their 30th anniversary, Savithri and her paralyzed husband visit their own resort in simple attire but are mistaken for frauds and brutally humiliated by the greedy manager Rithika. Unaware they are billionaire Rudra Varma’s parents, she escalates her cruelty. When the truth is revealed, revenge turns into kidnapping, leading to a tense showdown where justice finally prevails.
